about: Hand reviews of provider addresses that redirect to another domain. Read by afterward.sources.link_review, which links an off-site redirect only where something corroborates that the destination is still the provider the federal record names. An entry applies to exactly the filed_host -> destination pair it records: if the redirect moves, the entry stops matching and the link falls back to unresolved rather than carrying a stale blessing onto a page nobody looked at. Never write an entry to make a link work. Write one only for something you established, put what you established in evidence, and date it.

statuses.same_provider: The destination is the organisation the record names, moved. Linked as filed.
statuses.unrelated: Somebody else's live site is at the address now. Not linked; the page says the address leads somewhere unrelated.
statuses.for_sale: The address is being advertised for sale. Not linked; the page says so and tells the reader to look the school up by name.

entries.evidence: Opened during the hand review recorded in docs/soft-404-provider-links-2026-08-05.md: the address serves an Indonesian gambling site with nothing to do with the college, which is in Van Nuys. Published as a working 'Provider's website' link on four program pages until this entry.
Opened during the hand review recorded in docs/soft-404-provider-links-2026-08-05.md: the address serves an Indonesian lottery site, unrelated to the Fontana truck-driving school that filed it.

Opened during the hand review recorded in docs/soft-404-provider-links-2026-08-05.md: the address serves a Baltimore glaucoma-screening charity. A real and reputable site, and not this Los Angeles college's, which is the whole point: nothing mechanical separates it from a rebrand.

Seven filed URLs all end at hugedomains.com/domain_profile.cfm?d=dronitek.com, a listing offering dronitek.com itself for sale; the title review in docs/soft-404-provider-links-2026-08-05.md read the same listing ('DronitEk.com is for sale | HugeDomains').
Ends at hugedomains.com/domain_profile.cfm?d=aselbeauty.com, a listing for the filed address itself; title read on 2026-08-05 as 'AselBeauty.com is for sale | HugeDomains'.
Ends at expireddomains.com/domain/intechcollege.com, a listing for the filed address itself; title read on 2026-08-05 as 'intechcollege.com — Buy this expired domain | ED.com'.

entries.provider_name: Transportation Guidance and Assistance Truck Driving School
entries.evidence: Ends at expireddomains.com/domain/catruckschool.com, a listing for the filed address itself, read on 2026-08-05 alongside the other three.

Two filed course pages end at unstoppabledomains.com/d/maiquelascosmetology.net, a marketplace listing for the filed address itself. The academy's own root answered separately with its 'Page Not Found' screen, so this entry is about the address, not about the school.

The college's own accreditation evidence file is a printout of its catalog footed https://westhillslemoore.elumenapp.com/catalog/22-23/home, so eLumen is its catalogue platform (lemoorecollege.edu/about/accreditation/iser-2024/standard1c/ic2_02_whcl_catalog_web.pdf). West Hills College Lemoore was renamed Lemoore College in April 2024, which is why the filed domain no longer matches the destination.

Cuesta College's Academic Senate Curriculum Committee page names https://cuesta.curriqunet.com/ as where its courses and programs are searched (cuesta.edu/about/college-resources/academicsenate/curriculum-committee.html). The vendor renamed curricunet.com to curriqunet.com and moved each college onto its own subdomain.

The college's Academic Policy and Planning Committee page names CurriQunet META as its curriculum system and links https://hancockcollege.curriqunet.com/catalog as the college catalog (hancockcollege.edu/app/index.php).

rcoe.us is the Riverside County Office of Education, which runs the School of Career Education the record names; the redirect lands on rcoe.us/programs/school-of-career-education/, that programme's own page.

Montebello Unified School District's own Adult Education page lists http://aemusd.com/ as the website for all four of its adult schools, Montebello Adult among them (montebello.k12.ca.us, Adult Education).

The EDUCAUSE .edu registry still records palladium.edu as registered to Palladium Technical Academy, 10229 Lower Azusa Rd., Temple City, CA (record updated 2026-05-22), so the redirect is set by the school rather than by a buyer of a lapsed address. Worth re-checking: third-party directories still list palladiumta.com, and the destination domain was created 2026-03-09.

The Better Business Bureau record filed as '1-on-1 Dave Truck Driving School' now carries the business name '1 on 1 Truck Academy' at the same address, 3602 West Capitol Ave, West Sacramento, and still lists davetruckdrivingschool.com as its website.
211LA's agency record for Antelope Valley Adult School gives avadulted.org as its website.
The destination's contact page gives 1815 West 54th Street, Los Angeles CA 90062, the principal address on the California business filing for Untouchable Apprentice Training & Academy LLC.

The EDUCAUSE .edu registry lists angelesuniversity.edu's registrant as Angeles University, 3440 Wilshire Boulevard, Suite 310, Los Angeles, with an administrative contact at angelescollege.edu — the filed institution under a new name. Name similarity alone would not have settled this, and the automatic rules correctly did not.
